verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches on data control indirectly. The web API is said to 'manage and export data' (sentry-docs-14, sentry-docs-20), and the self-hosted option lets you run all of Sentry on your own server (sentry-docs-11), which implies ownership of stored data. Nothing explicitly documents retention controls or deletion workflows. Missing for 10: documented retention period settings, explicit event/issue/project deletion capabilities (UI or API), data deletion/GDPR request handling, and any independent corroboration.
